--- .gitattributes
+++ .gitattributes
+migrations/*.sql text eol=lf
+*.catalog.json text eol=lf
+.okm/** text eol=lf

--- package.json
+++ package.json
 {
   "name": "npm-app",
   "private": true,
-  "workspaces": ["packages/*"],
+  "workspaces": [
+    "packages/*"
+  ],
   "dependencies": {
-    "postgres": "^PEER"
+    "postgres": "^PEER",
+    "okmodel": "^OKMODEL_VERSION"
   },
   "scripts": {
-    "preinstall": "echo leave-me"
+    "preinstall": "echo leave-me",
+    "db:check": "npx okm check",
+    "db:plan": "npx okm migrate plan",
+    "db:apply": "npx okm migrate apply",
+    "db:status": "npx okm migrate status"
   }
 }

--- okmodel.config.ts
+++ okmodel.config.ts
+import { defineConfig } from "okmodel/migrate";
+
+// `database` is one target named default. A protected target is
+// `{ url, protected: true }` and refuses non-expand work (OKM1850).
+// Several environments use `targets`. Pass --target when there is more
+// than one. Omitting it is OKM1853.
+// Reviewed migrations are linted strict (lint: { migrations: "strict" }).
+// `okm init` writes this file. `okm generate init` writes the first migration.
+
+const database = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
+
+export default defineConfig({
+  schema: "./db/schema.ts",
+  migrations: "./migrations",
+  ...(typeof database === "string" && database.length > 0 ? { database } : {}),
+});
